definitions.explanation: Death that occurs immediately, without any interval of survival. Used in news reports about accidents, in medical contexts, and in gaming.

examples.japanese: {運転手|うんてんしゅ}は{即死|そくし}だった。
{事故|じこ}の{衝撃|しょうげき}で{即死|そくし}した。
examples.english: He died instantly from the impact of the accident.

examples.japanese: この{攻撃|こうげき}を{受|う}けると{即死|そくし}するので{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Be careful, because this attack will kill you instantly.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{即死|そくし}する (die instantly)
・{即死|そくし}だった (was dead on the spot)
・{即死|そくし}{攻撃|こうげき} (one-hit kill attack — gaming)

USAGE NOTES:
Frequently appears in news reports about traffic accidents and disasters. In gaming contexts, {即死|そくし} refers to attacks or traps that kill a character in one hit regardless of remaining health. The noun form is often used as a predicate with だった: {即死|そくし}だった (was an instant death / died on the spot).
